entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Smt. Rajkumari
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. U.P. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Ashraf
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.67 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Dhammaur, District Sultanpur.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married on 22.04.2016 and the entire matrimonial family used to harass her for dowry.
Subsequently, the daughter of the informant was killed to death on 29.03.2023.

The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, three abrasion injuries were observed on the left forearm, left leg and right arm which can happen at the time of lowering of the body.

sentences.text: Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the postmortem report not indicating any physical injuries and the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant who is a lady aged about 60 years, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Smt. Rajkumari be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
